items.source_en:
Complaint summary: Suspected contraband on site, threats from coworkers
Reporter Name: Jonathan Pesch 
Supervisor Name: Emile Codin 

Supervisor's Notes: Jon claims to have seen a weapon in another miner's luggage. He pointed the finger at Alex, the newest member of our crew. Jon says that when he told Alex that weapons aren't allowed at the site, Alex threatened him. 

Resolution: I searched Alex's bunk, along with everyone else's quarters, and didn't find any weapons. If he has any, he hid them really well. 

Disciplinary Action: I wrote Alex up for threatening Jon, and I'm keeping this report on file just in case anyone else sees a weapon. Jon's a solid guy, I don't think he'd make something like this up. And you never know with new miners...

보고자 성명: 조나단 페쉬
감독관 성명: 에밀 코댕

해결: 알렉스의 침상을 비롯, 전원 숙소를 수색했으나, 아무 무기를 찾지 못함. 만일 무기가 있었다면 잘 숨긴 듯.

징계 조치: 알렉스가 존을 위협했다고 보고함. 이 보고서는 무기가 발견될 경우를 대비해 신상과 함께 보관. 존은 근실한 인물로 일을 꾸며낼 거라 생각지 않음. 신입 광부는 알 수 없음...
